author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Attackers are exploiting a critical Gitea flaw (CVE-2026-20896) that bypasses authentication with a single HTTP header, exposing repositories and sensitive data. Sysdig researchers warn that attackers are actively exploiting a critical authentication bypass flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-20896 (CVSS score of 9.8), which affects Gitea official Docker images before version 1.26.3. “CVE-2026-20896 exploited 13 days after […]
title: Critical Gitea Docker Bug Under Active Exploitation Exposes Repositories and Secrets

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: CERT/CC warns an unpatched backdoor in several Tenda routers lets attackers bypass login and gain full admin access with a hidden password. CERT/CC published an alert documenting an undocumented authentication backdoor in multiple Tenda firmware versions, tracked as CVE-2026-11405. The flaw gives anyone who knows the right password full administrative access to the device’s web […]
title: Hidden Tenda Router Backdoor Grants Admin Access, No Patch Available

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Armored Likho APT uses AI-generated malware, phishing, and BusySnake Stealer to target governments and power grids in Russia, Kazakhstan, and Brazil. Kaspersky’s threat research team has documented a previously unknown APT group they’re calling Armored Likho, also tracked under the name Eagle Werewolf. title: AI-Generated Malware Powers New Armored Likho APT Campaign

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Januscape: A 16-year-old Linux KVM flaw lets cloud VM tenants crash hosts and potentially escape guests. It affects Intel and AMD systems. title: Januscape: 16-Year-Old Linux KVM Bug Enables Cloud VM Escape Attacks
